item.title: Measuring an Asteroid's Rotation Period From a Backyard Telescope
item.description: Using open photometric data and a consumer telescope, this study estimates the rotation period of asteroid (433) Eros through light-curve analysis, and examines where amateur measurement diverges from observatory-grade results.

item.title: Why the Collatz Conjecture Resists Elementary Attack
item.description: A guided tour of what is actually proven about the 3n+1 problem, and what has quietly become folklore.
